dataLocations.description: Dorst et al., cholinergic interneurons in the striatum: single cell patch clamp recordings with morphological reconstructions (dataset version f25ec9c9-2348-4a62-a6af-907d389f263d). The bucket holds one folder, ephy-ChIN-STR, with the data descriptor (.md and .txt), a spatial metadata spreadsheet and one folder per subject. Each cell folder holds original/ and, for four of the ten cells, derived/. The data descriptor's registry: './sbj*/cell*/original/*.pxp: Original single cell recordings in Igor Pro packed format (PXP). ./sbj*/cell*/derived/*.mat: Selected traces in Matlab format. ./sbj*/cell*/original/*.tif: Slice overview. ./sbj*/cell*/original/*.DAT: Spatial data registration overlay. ./sbj*/cell*/original/*.xml: Spatial data specification file.' The files are inside those subfolders, so file patterns cannot name them. Every entry of the bucket was listed.
